text:
monitor-bot: ALERT — Increased websocket connection resets observed from apac-edge-2 (15:42 UTC). 5xxs for realtime sessions + client disconnect spikes. Severity: Potential customer-impact.

sre-olivia: Investigating now. I've paged oncall. Marking as incident; creating thread for operations + customer comms.

oncall-bot: @sre-olivia assigned (rotation: eng-raj).

eng-raj: Looking at ingress logs — seeing repeated TLS renegotiation errors followed by ws reset code 1006. Suspect upstream proxy kernel module that got rolled ~20m ago. Pulling logs.

eng-raj: log excerpt:
2026-03-23T15:39:12Z edge-proxy apac-edge-2 ws: conn_id=abcd reset=1006 reason="tls renegotiate"
2026-03-23T15:39:12Z kernel: tcp_reset sent for flow 10.2.34.12:443 -> 172.18.0.55:52781

platform-anya: Confirmed recent packages rolled to apac-edge-2 at ~15:20 UTC. Rolling back the kernel module patch to the previous revision on the affected pool. Initiating canary rollback to one node first.

prod-mike: Impact — realtime sessions degraded for a small subset of APAC customers. Metrics: connection success rate down ~18% from baseline for apac-edge-2. No evidence of embeddings/generation backend errors.

cs-lina: I have a short list of impacted customers (internal): Tutorly, LocaleChat, and 3 dev sandbox tenants. Starting outreach to high-touch customers now; will escalate if we see >30% drop for any single tenant.

sre-olivia: Mitigations applied so far:
- Traffic weight shifted off apac-edge-2 to apac-edge-3 (gradual cutover).
- Kernel module rollback started (canary node rollback complete, monitoring).
- Increased ws keepalive and bumped proxy timeouts by +10s to reduce false resets.

sre-olivia: Current status — connection reset rate for apac-edge-2 dropping; overall APAC success rate recovering to -5% from baseline. Fallback routing holding steady.

eng-raj: Ran quick check commands:
# verify routing weights
curl -sS http://cluster-control/api/edges/apac | jq '.pools[] | {name,weight,health}'
# tail logs
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=edge-proxy -f | grep ws | tail -n 50

comms-jess: Drafting incident banner for status page and customer portal. Will use "Degraded realtime sessions in APAC; mitigations in progress". Link to interim status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/241980-apac-ws-degraded (updating).

sre-olivia: Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/ops/runbooks/ws-reset-apac-edge. Postmortem owner: eng-raj. ETA for rollback verification: 30 minutes, will update thread every 15.

cs-lina: Notifying customers now. I'll post copy of messages in #customer-updates when ready.

oncall-bot: Next check-in scheduled in 15 minutes.

comms-jess: Reaction :eyes: — will hold on broader comms until we hit >90% recovery or have clear mitigation.

sre-olivia: Next update: apac-edge-2 reset rate down to 6% (from 18%). Routing remains shifted. No data loss; transient reconnects only. Keeping incident open until full recovery and rollback verified.

eng-raj: Added temporary alert to suppress noisy alerts for the affected nodes to avoid paging cascade while we validate.

monitor-bot: Incident status updated on status page. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/241980-apac-ws-degraded — short desc + mitigation steps.

comms-jess: Preparing short customer-facing note: "We experienced transient real-time connection interruptions for some APAC sessions between 15:20–15:50 UTC. A code rollout triggered resets; we have rolled back the change and traffic is stable. No customer data was lost. A post-incident report will follow." Will share in 1:1 if CS wants edits.

sre-olivia: Closing actions assigned: eng-raj (postmortem), platform-anya (improve canary gating for kernel modules), prod-mike (validate SLAs), cs-lina/comms-jess (customer comms).

sre-olivia: STATUS: Mitigation in progress — degraded -> recovering. Next update at 15:55 UTC or earlier if things change.
